description: Control Linux encrypted block devices that are set up during system boot in /etc/crypttab.

parameters.name: backing_device
parameters.description: Path to the underlying block device or file, or the UUID of a block-device prefixed with UUID=.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the encrypted block device as it appears in the /etc/crypttab file, or optionally prefixed with /dev/mapper/, as it appears in the filesystem. /dev/mapper/ is stripped from name.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: A comma-delimited list of options. See crypttab(5) for details.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Encryption password, the path to a file containing the password, or - or unset if the password should be entered at boot.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to file to use instead of /etc/crypttab. This might be useful in a chroot environment. Default: "/etc/crypttab"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Use present to add a line to /etc/crypttab or update its definition if already present. Use absent to remove a line with matching name. Use opts_present to add options to those already present; options with different values are updated. Use opts_absent to remove options from the existing set. Choices: "absent" "opts_absent" "opts_present" "present"

examples:
- name: Set the options explicitly a device which must already exist
  community.general.crypttab:
    name: luks-home
    state: present
    opts: discard,cipher=aes-cbc-essiv:sha256

- name: Add the 'discard' option to any existing options for all devices
  community.general.crypttab:
    name: '{{ item.device }}'
    state: opts_present
    opts: discard
  loop: '{{ ansible_mounts }}'
  when: "'/dev/mapper/luks-' in item.device"

- name: Add entry to /etc/crypttab for luks-home with password file
  community.general.crypttab:
    name: luks-home
    backing_device: UUID=123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
    password: /root/keys/luks-home.key
    opts: discard,cipher=aes-cbc-essiv:sha256
    state: present
